title: Japan Ministry of Justice operates an official English-language immigration and residence information portal
statement: As of the captured baseline date, the Japanese Ministry of Justice operates https://www.moj.go.jp/EN/ as an official English-language portal that publishes immigration, residence, citizenship and foreigner-related service information. This rule does not assert the complete content of Japanese immigration law; it confirms only the existence and official ownership of the stated service channel.
rationale: The approved immigration assessment identifies the Ministry of Justice as the competent authority. The approved source certification confirms the same official source. The captured baseline snapshot provides immutable evidence of the portal content at the time of retrieval.
evidence_excerpt: Japanese Ministry of Justice English portal (https://www.moj.go.jp/EN/) retrieved over HTTPS with content covering immigration, residence, citizenship and foreigner-related services.
